key_insight: Trustworthy AI-assisted formalization in scientific computing requires expert feedback tailored to failure modes across abstraction layers.
engineering_relevance: The study offers workflow guidance for using AI agents to formalize scientific computing mathematics while preserving mathematical soundness.
method: Study AI-assisted formalization across scientific computing abstraction layers.
Classify failure modes and the expert feedback needed to recover soundness.
Derive workflows for recurring proof patterns.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports cross-layer case studies evaluating proof completion and failure causes, but provides no quantitative success rates.
watch_item: Computational procedures and modeling transformations can be harder to formalize than self-contained theorems and require careful expert interpretation.
paper_title: AI-Assisted Auto-formalization for Trustworthy Scientific Computing: Case Studies and Lessons Learned
